name: Disable WiFi U-APSD Power Saving
description: Disables WiFi U-APSD power-saving behavior on supported wireless adapters to reduce latency spikes and improve responsiveness during online gaming or real-time workloads.

description_i18n.en: Disables WiFi U-APSD power-saving behavior on supported wireless adapters to reduce latency spikes and improve responsiveness during online gaming or real-time workloads.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert das WLAN-U-APSD-Energiesparverhalten auf unterstützten Adaptern, um Latenzspitzen zu reduzieren und die Reaktionsfähigkeit bei Online-Spielen oder Echtzeitaufgaben zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le comportement d'économie d'énergie U-APSD sur les adaptateurs WiFi compatibles pour réduire les pics de latence et améliorer la réactivité lors du jeu en ligne ou des tâches temps réel.

warnings.title: Power usage increase
warnings.message: Disabling U-APSD may slightly increase power consumption, especially on laptops

warnings.title: Adapter
warnings.message: Network adapters may briefly reconnect or require a driver-level refresh for changes to fully apply

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script uses Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty to detect and modify advanced properties on wireless network adapters that match patterns like UAPSD, WMM Power Save, or WiFi Multimedia Power Save It sets the RegistryValue to '0' or DisplayValue to 'Disabled/Off'
